## Answers

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`), whose `CheckAndPresign` re-presigns S3-backed attachment URLs in batches of 100, refreshing any presign older than ~4 days (5-day expiry) — `runner.go:47-131` — **schedule**: one immediate `RunOnce` at startup plus a ticker every 12 h (`runnerInterval = 12h`, `runner.go:27`; loop `runner.go:29-41`) — **wiring**: `server.Server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:162-171` (construct at :162, immediate run :163, goroutine :169), called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`, the actual HTTP call being `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`. Protection: dial-time SSRF guard `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) installed as the shared client's Transport (`webhook.go:32-37`), which resolves the host and rejects reserved ranges via `isReservedIP` / `reservedCIDRs` (loopback, RFC-1918, 169.254.0.0/16 IMDS, IPv6 equivalents) — `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54`; plus config-time `webhook.ValidateURL` (`validate.go:62-83`) called on webhook create/update (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:53,106`). Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`validate.go:41`), set from `--allow-private-webhooks` at `cmd/memos/main.go:49`.

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3`, the shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` contract returned by any provider; note it is a shared type, not a Go interface). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` — OAuth2/OIDC-style provider (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20`, `NewIdentityProvider` :27, `ExchangeToken` :47, `UserInfo` :83), selected at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:120-121` for `IdentityProvider_OAUTH2`. It is the only concrete protocol implementation.

**h04** — **No.** `mysql.NewDB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`) has exactly one caller, `db.NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:14`, call site :22) — graph callers query returned that single row; and the only file in the repo importing `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` is `store/db/db.go:8` (grep over all Go files). No test or production code constructs it directly.

**h05** — **Explicit Go code**, inside the per-driver `DeleteUser` transaction; there is no DB-level cascade for reactions. Evidence: sqlite `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` / `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380-388`, `:400-403`, invoked at `:96` and `:102` inside `DB.DeleteUser` `:29`); same pair in `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:420,438` and `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:383,401`; entry point `store.Store.DeleteUser` → `driver.DeleteUser` (`store/user.go:171-181`), called from `APIV1Service.DeleteUser` (`server/router/api/v1/user_service.go:414`). Absence of a DB rule: `reaction` table has no FK/cascade (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, mysql `:91-98`, postgres `:91-98`); the only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the current schema is `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`).

**h06** — Handlers (RPC methods) that can reach an outbound POST to a user-configured webhook URL:
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`
- `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`
- `APIV1Service.DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` (and `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemoComment`, `connect_services.go:378`)
- `APIV1Service.SetMemoAttachments` / `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_attachment_service.go:16`, `memo_relation_service.go:16` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`, `memo_update_helpers.go:66`)

Convergence: all paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` (enqueue), and the single delivery function it drains into is `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07** — Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`):
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- (auth gate on private instances) `FileServerService.getCurrentUser` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `store.Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache` first, `store/user.go:150`)
- `store.Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `store.Driver.ListUsers` (interface) — `store/driver.go:47`
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` (default driver) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (mysql `store/db/mysql/user.go:84`, postgres `store/db/postgres/user.go:87`)
- image bytes then decoded from the stored `user.avatar_url` data URI: `parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`, served at `fileserver.go:209`

**h08** — Two declarers:
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked in production** — callers: `server.Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`) and `s3presign.Runner.Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked** — certified-zero callers from the graph; `memopayload.NewRunner` (`runner.go:19`) also has zero callers; text search for `RunOnce` finds only the two runner files plus `server/server.go:163`

**h09** — **8 declarations** of a method named `Close`: `v1.SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `cache.Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `cache.Interface.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:31`), `mysql.DB.Close` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`), `postgres.DB.Close` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `sqlite.DB.Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `store.Driver.Close` (`store/driver.go:12`), `store.Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`).
Invoked from non-test server code:
- `store.Store.Close` ← `server.Server.Shutdown` (`server/server.go:146`)
- `v1.SSEHub.Close` ← `server.Server.closeLongLivedConnections` (`server/server.go:206`)
- `cache.Cache.Close` (×3 caches) ← `store.Store.Close` (`store/store.go:74-76`)
- `store.Driver.Close` ← `store.Store.Close` (`store/store.go:78`), dispatching to `sqlite.DB.Close` under a default install (mysql/postgres only when so configured)

**h10** — `filter.renderer.addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — ≈28 inbound calls (14 distinct caller methods across `internal/filter/render.go`, e.g. `renderScalarComparison` :304, `renderTagInList` :434, `foldedLike` :578). Runner-up under `internal/`: `filter.Schema.Field` (`internal/filter/schema.go:67`, ≈19).

**h11** — 1st: **`store.User`** (`store/user.go:29`) — referenced from ~6 packages outside the data layer: `server/router/api/v1` (37 refs), `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/api/v1/test`. 2nd: **`store.Memo`** (`store/memo.go:35`) — ~4 outside packages: `server/router/api/v1` (22), `server/notification` (7), `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`. (`store.Attachment`, `store/attachment.go:16`, reaches only ~2: `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/api/v1`.)

**h12** — Concrete method: `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`, with the INSERT built and executed at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41-47`. Determination: the driver name defaults to `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` and flag default `:130`); that value flows into `profile.Driver` (`cmd/memos/main.go:43`) and selects the concrete driver in the factory switch `db.NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:18-24`, sqlite branch :19-20); the store then delegates without re-dispatching: `store.Store.CreateMemo` → `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109-114`) over the `store.Driver` interface (`store/driver.go:29`). The mysql/postgres `CreateMemo` implementations (`store/db/mysql/memo.go:16`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`) are unreachable without `--driver`.

**h13** — Implementation: the unexported `markdown.service` struct — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (methods `ExtractAll` :356, `GenerateSnippet` :264, `RenderHTML` :255, `RenameTag` :425, etc.); it is the only implementation of `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`). Construction: `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called once in production from `v1.NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`) (also `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:24` in tests). Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:85`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14** — Computation site: `markdown.service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-421`), wired into the memo payload by `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, assigning `Payload.Tags` and `Payload.Property` at :85-86). Triggers: `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo` when the `content` field mask path is present (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`), and the bulk `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52`, currently uninvoked — see h08). Extracted: hashtags (deduped, case-preserved, `markdown.go:376-378,418`), `@mentions` (`:379-381`), and `Property` = `Title` (leading H1, `:383-389`), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (`:392-405`).

**h15** — Distinct visibility-enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read gate; archived + PRIVATE/PROTECTED) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility narrowing (anonymous → PUBLIC only; else CEL filter `creator_id == N || visibility in [...]`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-226`
- Comment listing / relation listing / converter filters using the same visibility predicate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:157-160`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:108-111`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:183-186`
- Comment creation gate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33-45`
- Reaction list/upsert gates — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29-37` and `:82-85`
- Memo-attachment listing gate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-216`
- Attachment access via memo visibility — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:436-...` (`checkAttachmentAccess` :422)
- HTTP file server attachment permission (`checkAttachmentPermission`, incl. share-token fallback) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677` and `:699`
- SSE fan-out filter — `SSEClient.canReceive`, `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-144` (applied in `Broadcast` :123)
- RSS feeds restricted to PUBLIC — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`

**r01** — Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the codebase (no `redis` dependency in `go.mod`; no source match across 343 Go files). Caching is an in-process, `sync.Map`-backed TTL cache: `store/cache/cache.go:66-197`, instantiated three times in `store.New` — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` (`store/store.go:47-53`). User entries use the shared default TTL of **10 minutes** with 5-minute cleanup and 1000-item cap (`store/store.go:40-45`; identical defaults `store/cache/cache.go:57-64`); `userCache.Set` is always called without an explicit TTL (`store/user.go:98,122,132,143,167`), so no per-user override exists.

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware, per-user or otherwise. Text search for `limiter|throttl|golang.org/x/time/rate` matched nothing in 343 Go files (`golang.org/x/time` is only an indirect dependency). The registered Echo middleware is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`) plus the static/SPA handlers (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54-59`); the Connect interceptor chain is Metadata → Logging → Recovery → Auth (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-138`), and the gateway uses only `gatewayAuthMiddleware` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:96-97`). The only concurrency limits are semaphores for thumbnail/image work (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:59-60`).

**r03** — Premise is wrong: no cron scheduler runs in this server, so no nightly cleanup job exists at any time. A cron implementation is present (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go:12-176`, parser `internal/scheduler/parser.go:30`), but `scheduler.New` and `Scheduler.Register` have **certified-zero callers** in the graph, and the only files importing `internal/scheduler` are its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`). Background work is instead a plain ticker: the 12-hour S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41`, started at `server/server.go:162-171`) and the cache's 5-minute expiry sweep (`store/cache/cache.go:200-215`).

**r04** — Premise is wrong: there is no message broker — neither NATS nor RabbitMQ appears in `go.mod` or any source file, and no queue is declared in any infrastructure sense. Webhook delivery is in-process: a buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue` with capacity 128 (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) drained by 4 goroutine workers started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `Post` (`:46`); producers use `PostAsync`, which drops the event with a warning when the buffer is full (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184-196`).

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or server (no `graphql` match in the repo; no GraphQL dependency in `go.mod`). The public API is protobuf-defined gRPC exposed two ways: Connect RPC handlers for browsers (`server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, registered at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:139-141`) and a gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON surface under `/api/v1/...` (~77 generated routes, e.g. `POST /api/v1/memos`, `GET /api/v1/{name=memos/*}`, `PATCH /api/v1/{user.name=users/*}` — `proto/gen/api/v1/*.pb.gw.go`, registered at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:96` / `server/server.go:88`). Non-RPC HTTP doors: `GET /api/v1/sse` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:25`), `/file/attachments/:uid/:filename` and `/file/users/:identifier/avatar` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:123-124`), RSS `/explore/rss.xml`, `/u/:username/rss.xml` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:72,111`), `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:128,143`), `/healthz` (`server/server.go:67`), and the MCP service (`server/router/mcp`, registered `server/server.go:96`). Proto sources of truth live in `proto/api/v1/`.
